name: Kell Prayer Wheel
description: A 2312 prayer wheel with a Steward chip inside, spinning nothing. Any shop in any era will pay for it.

name: Ash Camp Blade
description: A 2148 hand-forged blade. Worth a fortune in a century where nothing is made by hand.

name: Hunter Lens
description: The eye of a Board-era hunter drone. It still tracks whoever holds it.

name: Folded Page
description: A page from the chapel register, dated twice. Neither date has happened yet.
